speaker: Lady Elowen Moonwhisper

lines: You're new.
You: "Is it that obvious?"
You still have money.
You: "What does that mean?"
Give it a week.
The King has raised the taxes again.
You: "Then why doesn't someone stop him?"
Someone tried.
You: "What happened?"
He became King.
I am Elowen Moonwhisper. I keep the Moonwater, for as long as he lets me.
His collectors came to the glade last spring. They measured the fountains.
There is an old law, older than his throne. He wrote none of it, so he cannot unwrite it.
Anyone strong enough to take the King's Castle may claim the Crown.
He doesn't fear the law. He's certain no one will ever be strong enough.
(She turns toward the far-off towers of the King's Castle.)
The King owns the land. The King owns the castles. The King owns the law.
But there is one thing he does not own.
You: "What's that?"
Your destiny.
~  C R O W N F A L L  ~
Your story begins...
The law calls it the Royal Challenge. Four things stand between you and it.
First, strength. Reach combat level 100.
Armour first, then the levels. The dungeon beside our glade will test you.
Second, stone. Own a castle of your own.
Quests fill the purse. Dungeons make you strong enough to spend it.
Third, a name people trust. Complete every quest in the realm.
Each one is a promise kept. He keeps none.
Fourth, people who will stand with you.
Lead or join a clan of at least twenty souls. One sword never took a throne.
When all four are done, come back to me. Not before.
Drink from the Moonwater when you're weary. It will always know you.

warden_thorne.speaker: Warden Thorne Briarwing
pages: Halt. Oh... a friend of the Lady? Then pass, and welcome.
Mind the crypt to the south-east. The dead sleep badly there.
I've guarded this glade for three hundred winters.
First they taxed the honey. Now they want the water.

tumbleroot.speaker: Tumbleroot the Gnome
pages: Potions! Tonics! Moonwater draughts, nearly legal!
Have a look, have a look. Mind the green one, it bites.

pip_dewdrop.speaker: Pip Dewdrop
pages: Lady Elowen says the fountain sings if you're kind to it.
Are you the hero? You look a bit muddy for a hero.
The tax man asked how much a wish weighs.
Lady Elowen told him to go and weigh his own.
